Wary of all but their own species, an aggressive creature will use 
any opportunity to prove dominance over its territory. When 
not in combat they will use intimidation to aggrandizing their 
prowess with shows of strength and size. Th is can take the form 
of standing tall to look imposing, stamping their feet, or making 
loud noises to display their might.
Behavior Modifi cation - Aggressive creatures roll with Advantage 
if its size is larger than the Traveler(s).
1: Disadvantage on attack rolls
2-4: -10 ft. to its Movement Speed
5-8: No modifi cation
9-11: Raise AC by 1
12: Advantage on attack rolls
Behavior Modifi cation - Defensive creatures do not react to a 
Traveler's size.
1: Lower AC by 1
2-4: Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks
5-8: No modifi cation
9-11: Advantage on Constitution checks
12: Raise AC by 1
Often more concerned with fi nding food, or simply just not 
intelligent enough to notice anything outside its natural 
instinctual triggers, a defensive creature often has little reaction 
besides protecting itself when met with any other species.

Numerous sightings of a pod of illithisk stalking the beach. Aggressively tearing up fi shing nets, single manned vessels and 
attacking lone fi shermen. Looking for a Traveler to either frighten them away or slay them for good.
Job: Six Brutal illithisk are seen at sundown, roaming around dangerously within 1 mile of a coastal village. 
Aggressively attacking any creatures on sight. Success: Slay or incapacitate all six Brutal Illithisk.
Variant Addition • Brutal Illithisk: +1 AC, +2 DEX, + 2 STR
Pod Aggressors Th e brutal illithisk has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its 
allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.
Something's not right and us huntsmen need the studied eye of a Traveler to see what's goin on here. In the dead of the night, 
wild animals are being slaughtered by the cliffs, but not eaten. My hunters are calling the meat cursed and won't touch it. 
Either stop whats doin the killing or prove to my men it ain't no curse.
Job:  A wayward acrynn is venturing out of the caves to slaughter whatever it can get its scythe-like arms on. 
Either wait for night or track it back to its lair. Success: Slay or incapacitate the Stalking Acrynn.
Stalking Acrynn • Variant Additions: + 4 INT, +10 Movement Speed
Multiattack Th e acrynn makes three attacks, using Scything Limbs and Mandibles in any combination. 
BONUS ACTION - Agile Killer Whenever the stalking acrynn successfully Attacks a creature, it may Dash. 
Th is movement does not provoke Opportunity attacks.

Each dawn, herdsmen near the northern Wealdwoods of Last Bloom fi nd another of their herd beasts slaughtered, leaving 
nothing but a half consumed carcass and large avian tracks into the woods. Please send help and hunt down this voracious 
predator! 
Job: A single, uniquely large calitross is preying on herd animals in the dead of night. It is recommended to 
draw out the beast with live prey. Success: Kill or subdue the Grizzled Calitross.
Grizzled Calitross • Variant Additions: Size Medium, +1 AC, + 2 STR, +16 HP, Add 1 Damage Die to each of its 
attack types.
Lone Stalker Th e grizzled calitross stalker has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide while 
within the Wealdwoods. 
I heard tell of an oasis within the Grayfynn that shines like a sapphire in the sun. Our caravans can barely survive the trek 
with our stores of water and we're looking to chart a new trail. We'd be more than grateful if a Traveler could fi nd and map 
out the location of this potential life saving oasis.
Job: Travel through the arid landscape to fi nd the storied oasis. Success: Marking a map along the way to help 
tradesmen potentially use it.
Scenario: Search for the oasis in the wide open plains, DC 17 Wisdom (Survival) check.Th e Tracking roll can be 
attempted a total of three times. Success: Th e Traveler fi nds the hidden oasis. Failure: Th e Traveler loses an hour 
of tracking and gains one level of Exhaustion. Upon discovery, the oasis is a wellspring of life of abundance, a 
Traveler attempting to fi sh at the location can add ±2 to the range result on what fi sh they catch. Th ough, this 
oasis is a safe haven for tartakka, a Traveler must be quiet and attempt a DC 10 Dexterity (Stealth) check or DC 
10 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check every hour they spend at the oasis, otherwise 1d3 tartakka will become 
agitated and attack the Traveler.

Diffi culty: Easy
Th ey call them mindless beasts but my korruk Pokku is family! Something has made him sick, his scales are all gray and I'm 
scared he's going to die. Please if there's anyone reading this, he needs some vigael and a Traveler to fi nd out what's wrong!
Job: Administer a vial of vigael to the ailing korruk and assess what has made it sick. Success: Heal and discover 
the medical issue.
Scenario: Travel to a small Farplains village to see to the sick korruk. Give the korruk one vial of vigael and 
perform a DC 16 Intelligence (Medicine) check. Success: Th e korruk heals 1d6 Hit Points and the Traveler fi gures 
out the thistlespire roots that it has been eating are tainted with a fungus. Failure: Th e korruk reacts violently 
and attacks the Traveler. It is recommended that the Traver uses non-lethal force to subdue the beast.

My tough little vinnirex can't keep this up any longer, the khanith are getting bolder each day and I don't know if my 
bloomux herd will make it to harvest season. Looking for a Traveler to come help keep my herd alive and happy!
Job: Defend a bloomux herd from an incoming khanith attack for a whole day. Success: At least 1 bloomux 
survives the day. 
Scenario: Five bloomux graze on a fi eld of flowers for a full day (12 hours). Two Tamed vinnirex accompany the 
Traveler and both the vinnirex and bloomux treat them as allies. Four separate waves of 1d6+3 khanith attack 
at random times throughout the length of the day.

Naturally wary of all species not of their own, a wary creature's 
fi rst instinct is to escape any encounter, whether the other species 
is friendly or not. While susceptible to Animal Handling or other 
forms of appeasement through offerings of food, they will often 
attempt to escape any attempt of being approached. Only through 
a calm persistence will they eventually feel at ease around a new 
species.

The jellyfish's mantle contains 
a glowing bubble of bacteria, 
the methane produced by them 
allows the jellyfish to regulate 
its buoyancy in the deepest 
underground lakes within the 
Umbrawells. Like most jellyfish 
the creature contains little to no 
nutritional value, and aquatic 
predators use them more for 
the gentle light they emit in the 
black water, than any actual 
sustenance.
